warnings: Gable-end elevation. Grid 1 and 2 at a printed 6.00 m, chain 0.10 / 1.40 / 3.20 / 1.40 / 0.10 -- identical to the A-08 floor plan's bottom chain, so the two sheets agree exactly on the block's width.
Wall build-up is split: ผ3 (zinc sheet on steel studs) in the gable above the eave line, ผ2 (rendered concrete block) below it. Both tags come from A-03's finish schedule.
The 1.65 m rise above the +2.55 eave is consistent between both views on this sheet and with A-10 -- unlike the main building, whose ridge height is given two different ways on A-06 (2.25 vs ~2.46).
